test_description: Generate a monthly bill for an active account with a valid meter read.
expected_result: Bill is generated with a calculated bill amount.

test_description: Prevent normal bill generation when the meter read is missing.
expected_result: Bill is placed in Exception status with no bill amount.

test_description: Prevent normal bill generation when the meter read is invalid or negative.
expected_result: Bill is placed in Exception status with no bill amount.

test_description: Apply the correct customer-segment rate plan during bill calculation.
expected_result: Bill amount reflects the assigned rate plan base charge and tiered usage rates.

test_description: Generate one monthly meter read per active meter and billing cycle.
expected_result: Each meter has one read per monthly billing cycle.

test_description: Allow estimated meter reads to produce bills while retaining estimated read status.
expected_result: Estimated reads can be billed and remain marked as Estimated.

test_description: Create a billing exception for missing or invalid meter reads.
expected_result: Billing exception record is created and linked to the bill and account.

test_description: Assign severity and resolution status to billing exceptions.
expected_result: Exception includes severity and resolution status.

test_description: Create service requests from billing exceptions.
expected_result: Service request is created and linked to the exception, bill, account, and customer.

test_description: Flag inactive accounts with billing activity as data quality exceptions.
expected_result: Inactive-account billing records are classified as high-severity exceptions.
